tess.k: Quick alert 026-03-23 09:12Z 0260found plaintext AWS creds in a staging vault-proxy debug dump mounted to /var/log. Looks like an old service user `backup-staging`. Pinging @omar @lucy for rotation & triage.

omar: Can you paste a redacted snippet and pod name?

tess.k: redacted snippet:
```
{"backup":{"access_key":"AKIA***REDACTED","secret":"***REDACTED***","bucket":"redwood-staging-backups"}}
```
Pod: staging-vault-proxy-2 (ns=staging).

lucy: Immediate plan: 1) take backup jobs offline, 2) create new IAM key, 3) update Vault secret path, 4) revoke old key, 5) tighten RBAC for proxy SA. I'll open SEC ticket.

omar: Also disable the debug handler that wrote dumps (it was added to help an earlier incident). If KMS-wrapped blobs were unwrapped, check Vault audit logs.

tess.k: Removing handler now and restarting pod.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Quick scan in staging namespace for cache_dump patterns. Found one file in staging-vault-proxy-2. No other matches.

lucy: Commands I'll run: 
```
# create key
aws iam create-access-key --user backup-staging
# update vault
vault kv put secret/staging/backup access_key=AKIA... secret_key=...
# revoke old key after validation
aws iam delete-access-key --access-key-id OLDID --user backup-staging
```
I'll also open PR to change backup-staging IAM policy from `s3:*` to `s3:GetObject,s3:PutObject` scoped to the bucket.

omar: After rotation, run cluster-wide grep for `AKIA` in build logs and images, and enable CI pre-publish secret-scan. Also schedule KMS rewrap if any unwrap events are found.

tess.k: Pod restarted; debug handler removed. Quarantining log object in GCS and snapshotting to secure bucket for forensics.

lucy: Rotation done. New keys in Vault, old keys deleted. Backup job tested and wrote objects to bucket. RBAC change PR opened and assigned to @omar.

omar: Applied RBAC tighten at 15:18Z. Replaced clusterrolebinding with namespace role. Vault audit unwrapping retention increased to 90d and unwrapping events alert enabled.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Final quick-scan clear. Locking thread in 24h if no objections. :lock:

tess.k: Thanks everyone, filing postmortem follow-up with checklist and owners.
